mutations.name: the base render is read at the head instead of the merge base
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow records a changed snapshot's share of the content box, read from the merge base and the head

mutations.name: the snapshot cap counts only measured pairs, not added or removed shots
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow lists added and removed snapshots unmeasured by share, and measures none past maxSnapshots

mutations.name: token paths count a test file under the token directory
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow matches the public API, token and harness paths, a token test aside

mutations.name: a configured maxBytes is ignored for the default blob cap
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow records a blob that is not a PNG, or over maxBytes, as unmeasured

mutations.name: visualThreshold mode off still measures the visual delta
kills: the merge evidence under shepherd.visualThreshold shadow reads no blob and records nothing when the repo's mode is off
